newsitem.title: UK: Soymeal prices jump on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal prices jump on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: High protein soymeal sellers jumped by as much as 10 stg a tonne on the UK meals and feeds market following the higher to limit-up close in Chicago on Friday.
Traders said buyers were keeping a low profile with only those who were desperate for material showing their hands.

"No one believes the market at the moment and very few people feel the rise in Chicago prices is justified. Buyers on the whole are sitting back and waiting for the prices to fall again," said one trader.
On the rapemeal resale market spot material from the Liverpool mill fetched 127 stg a tonne, but trades said only a couple of small loads were involved.
